title: SYS010 malware uses Meta ads to spread and spy on Gmail and Outlook accounts
content_md:
SYS010 malware is using Meta advertisements to spread and spy on Gmail and Outlook email accounts while disguised as free background applications.

Article link: https://tugatech.com.pt/t95274-malware-sys010-usa-anuncios-da-meta-para-espiar-gmail-e-outlook
